text: How did you end up here on this side of the river?
zh: 你是怎么跑到河这边来的？

text: When will you be finished with the repair?
When will you be finished with the repair?
Do you have more information about the bridge?
zh: 关于那座桥，你还知道些别的吗？

text: Do you have more information about the bridge?
zh: 关于那座桥，你还知道些别的吗？

text: I guess. What do you want to know?
I was watching the bridge the other day, as Balder ordered to me to do so.
zh: 前几天我在看守那座桥，是巴尔德命令我这么干的。

text: However, I fell asleep in the middle of the night.
zh: 可是到了半夜，我睡着了。

text: He always feared an attack of the Royal Guard.
zh: 他一直担心皇家卫队会来袭击。

text: All of a sudden, I heard a loud noise and half of the bridge was missing.
zh: 突然间，我听到一声巨响，桥就塌了一半。

text: Shortly after, Balder was about to check on me. Needless to say he was pissed.
zh: 没过多久，巴尔德就来查岗了。不用说，他气坏了。

text: Ever since then, I've been repairing the bridge. But Balder ain't paying enough, so I am taking my time.
zh: 从那以后，我就一直在修桥。但巴尔德给的钱不够，所以我就慢慢磨。

text: They usually only operate in the city and nearby, but some of them were ordered to get rid of bandits.
zh: 他们通常只在城里和附近活动，但有一些奉命去清剿强盗。

text: Surprisingly, the king considers us as such, therefore we have to be cautious.
zh: 没想到，国王把我们也算成了强盗，所以我们不得不小心行事。

text: Balder ain't paying for the repair, and I am not doing overtime.
zh: 巴尔德不肯付修桥的钱，我可不加班。

text: If you want, you could speed up the repair in exchange for a few coins.
zh: 你要是愿意，可以出几个钱，让工程快一点。

text: 150 gold as compensation for the work sounds reasonable.
Thank you! This should speed up the repair.
zh: 谢了！这下修桥能快些了。

text: Sounds better. Here are the 100 gold coins.
Thank you! This should speed up the repair.
zh: 谢了！这下修桥能快些了。

text: So you ratted me out to Balder?
zh: 这么说你去巴尔德那儿告我的状了？

text: Looks like I'll have to find other ways to get gold, then.
zh: 那看来我只能另想办法搞金币了。

text: For you I'll make the special offer of 400 gold coins.
zh: 对你嘛，我开个特价：400金币。

text:
I am serious.
Whine to Balder if that's too much for you.
zh:
我是认真的。
嫌贵就去找巴尔德哭吧。
